observations: Photo 0 shows a Sigma-branded zoom lens with a Canon EF-style mount (rear electrical contacts visible) and a zoom ring labeled with focal lengths including 12–24.
Photo 1 shows the front element; no obvious cracks, but there is visible reflection/shine and no clear view of internal haze/fungus.
Photo 2 shows the side text; the lens appears to be a Sigma 12–24mm class lens, with additional markings but not fully readable for exact series/version.

identity.model: 12-24mm (exact series/version not fully readable from photos)

claims.claim: US used Sigma 12-24 mm lens for Canon camera.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a Sigma 12–24mm-labeled lens with a Canon EF-style mount.

claims.claim: The lens looks new and in perfect working condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show cosmetic condition, but no proof of autofocus, aperture operation, stabilization (if any), or optical performance.

risks.risk: Autofocus/aperture may not work correctly (common hidden issue not visible in photos).
risks.proof: Video/clip of the lens focusing on a subject at near and far distances on a Canon body, plus a shot sequence showing aperture changes (or EXIF aperture values) while zooming.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / potentially faulty autofocus or aperture.

risks.risk: Optical problems like fungus, haze, or internal scratches may not be obvious from reflections.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the front and rear elements in bright light (no hand reflections), and a test shot of a bright uniform surface (e.g., white wall) at wide open and stopped down.
risks.if_unproven: Price as optics possibly imperfect (no guarantee of clean glass).

risks.risk: Zoom ring may have play, stiffness, or zoom creep.
risks.proof: Clip showing zooming through the full range while holding the lens horizontally and vertically to check for creep, plus a side-by-side comparison of zoom ring smoothness.

risks.risk: Mount compatibility/version mismatch (e.g., different Sigma 12–24 variants) could affect fit or performance.
risks.proof: Photo of the full model text/serial on the lens barrel and rear mount, and confirmation of exact Sigma model name from the lens itself.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the generic 12–24mm Sigma for Canon EF without assuming the exact best-matching variant.

proof_requests: Send a sharp photo of the full side label/model text (including exact Sigma series/version) and the rear mount contacts.
Provide a short video on a Canon body showing autofocus working (near + far) and aperture response while zooming.
Send clear element photos (front and rear) with minimal reflections, plus one test shot on a bright wall at 12mm and 24mm.
response.reason: The photos support that it is a Sigma 12–24mm lens for Canon EF, but the key pricing drivers (optical cleanliness and full working condition like autofocus/aperture) are not provable from the images alone.
